hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad-created token pools that overrides LP fees to 0 and instead collects a tiered, market-cap-based fee directly from each swap, with an optional time-decaying anti-sniper surcharge. Liquidity additions are restricted to the initial launch position, and fees are distributed to configurable dev and partner wallets in the same transaction.
